message: `net=example.com` names no numeric host: `net` is granted for the IPv4 or IPv6 addresses `nish:net` takes, one entry per address
`process.spawn=nish-no-such-program` names no program: a grant's program is found on `PATH`, or as a path from the root package's directory, when the program is built
`fs.read=./missing` names no directory: a grant's directory is resolved from the root package's directory and exists when the program is built
`unsafe=yes` gives `unsafe` an argument, which only `fs.read` and `fs.write` (a directory), `process.spawn` (a program) and `net` (a host) take: grant `unsafe` whole
